candidate.user_input: What is the requirement related to performance expectations for a full-time GitLab employee to be eligible for the Growth and Development Fund?
candidate.reference: Applicants must meet performance expectations in their role to be eligible for the Growth and Development Fund.
reference_contexts:
## Eligibility

To use the Growth and Development Fund, applicants must be full-time GitLab employees who meet performance expectations in their role and are not on leave status.

source_conditions: Applicants must be full-time GitLab employees.
Applicants must meet performance expectations in their role.
Applicants must not be on leave status.
missing_conditions: Applicants must be full-time GitLab employees.
Applicants must not be on leave status.
issues: The answer omits two eligibility criteria: being a full-time GitLab employee and not being on leave status. It only addresses the performance expectations requirement, so it is incomplete and not fully grounded.
